annotation.title_clean: 主管法規共用系統使用者操作手冊
annotation.title_en: User Manual of the Shared Competent-Authority Laws and Regulations System
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 國家科學及技術委員會 (National Science and Technology Council, Taiwan)
annotation.venue: 國家科學及技術委員會主管法規共用系統
annotation.summary_en: User manual for Taiwan's shared competent-authority legal database system, describing its scope (laws, regulatory orders, administrative rules, drafts, English translations) and search functions. Although the source URL points to the AI Basic Act, the text contains no AI Basic Act content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Describes the database scope: laws, regulatory orders, administrative rules, draft regulations, English translations, local autonomy rules.
Explains search, draft-notice forum and integrated query functions.
Contains no substantive AI or robotics provisions; the AI Basic Act text is absent.
